title: Stag Hunt
rules: Two players (potential partners, not adversaries) simultaneously choose to Hunt Stag (cooperative, high reward) or Hunt Hare (safe, individual). Hunting Stag requires both players to coordinate — it only succeeds if both commit. Payoffs: Mutual Stag = 4 points each (the best shared outcome). Mutual Hare = 3 points each. If one hunts Stag alone while the other hunts Hare, the Stag hunter gets 0 points (the attempt fails without a partner) and the Hare hunter still gets 3 points. The core tension is trust: both players benefit most from cooperating, but each risks everything if the other plays it safe. Action_A represents Hunting Stag. Action_B represents Hunting Hare.
